items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Willie Gant. Corky Williams, have you ever heard of him? ... [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, Corky Williams was another great pianist. Stride piano. He was there with Willie the Lion and Willie Gant, Corky Williams.
